{{Quote|An Imperial Quarantine Zone due to virus outbreak? Uh, am I the only one finding a frightening correlation here?|[[Cale Herron]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ID">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Investigate Dathomir|Lok}}</ref>}}
The '''Quarantine Zone''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] that was quarantined by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|outbreak]] of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|The situation is dire. A large portion of Dathomir had to be quarantined. You may have noticed the barriers.''"<br />"''Quarantined? Is there a disease?''"<br />"''Well yes, you could call it that. There was an accident, possibly sabotage, at an Imperial Research Facility and as a result several became infected.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Piett]] and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MMR" />}}
[[File:QuarantineZone.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A small Imperial starport near the Quarantine Zone.]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Empire was conducting secret and dangerous scientific research in the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on Dathomir, intending to engineer the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] in order to create super [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> However, in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> an accident happened in the Research Facility and the virus [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|escaped]] containment. The virus killed most of the people in the area and turned them into flesh-craving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures.<ref name="SWG:MMR" />

[[File:Quarantine_Zone_Dathomir.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The entrance of the Quarantine Zone.]]
In place of sterilizing the area with an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]], the Empire promptly established the Quarantine Zone to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> The Zone itself was surrounded by a tall fortified wall and its access was defended by a contingent of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] commanded by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Liam Waurie]].<ref name="SWG:GI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Get Inoculated|Dathomir}}</ref> Very few people who survived the initial virus outbreak managed to escape the lockdown, among them were [[Tyla Gallamby]], stormtrooper [[Tk-216]], and [[Illrian Nhagy]]<ref name="SWG:ID" /> The other survivors, mostly Imperial staff and prisoners, were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. They established five camps inside the area, [[Camp Alpha]], [[Camp Beta]], [[Camp Gamma]], [[Camp Delta]] and [[Camp Epsilon]], to try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation.<ref name="SWG:CLC" /> These survivors included [[Mika Horn]], [[Stephon Sprocketfire]], [[Kyra 'Naa]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Erlem Marh]], [[Zsu Val]],<ref name="SWG:FW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Forward Watch}}</ref> [[Jeb Maris]], [[Volo Madine]], [[Tripp D'jek]], stormtrooper [[TR-522]], [[Sogan Varga]],<ref name="SWG:DR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Deliver Radio|Dathomir}}</ref> [[Oona Wran]],<ref name="SWG:QZVCD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Quarantine Zone Virus Container Demolition}}</ref> stormtroopers [[HX-138]], [[KD-121]] and [[GT-643]],<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> [[Nils Cridmeen]],<ref name="SWG:SP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Shuttle Parts|Dathomir}}</ref> and [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Klex Fulgor]].<ref name="SWG:AA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Administrative Access|Dathomir}}</ref> The camps all came under regular attack from the zombies.<ref name="SWG:FW" /> Moreover, all rescue teams were attacked upon landing in the area and their members were killed before they could find the survivors.<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> Landing in the Quarantine Zone was eventually prohibited<ref name="SWG:FtS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find the Stormtroopers|Dathomir}}</ref> and Imperial authorities only tried to support the survivors with supply air drop.<ref name="SWG:MMR" />

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] discovered the accident in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility almost as quickly as the Empire itself. Immediately after the outbreak, before the establishment of the Quarantine Zone, a small unit of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troops]] landed near the Imperial Research and Prison Facility to investigate the place and rescue survivors. However, the Rebel forces were soon attacked by undead stormtroopers and were forced to withdraw. They suffered heavy casualties but managed to retreat to their extraction point. Nonetheless, when some Rebel soldiers started to display symptoms of the sickness, the evacuation mission was aborted and the few remaining Rebels were stuck in the Quarantine Zone.<ref name="SWG:TD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|Tripp D'jek|Dathomir}}</ref>

[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Zahara Cody]] and [[Trig Longo]] soon arrived on Dathomir and were dropped in Camp Alpha from the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="SWG:StT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak to Trig|Dathomir}}</ref> The four had survived the Blackwing virus outbreak on the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']] about [[1 BBY/Legends|two years before]].<ref name="DT">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref> Doctor Cody and Trig Longo had decided to distribute to the survivors of the Quarantine Zone an anti-virus developed by Dr. Cody during the ''Vector'' incident from her own immunity.<ref name="SWG:GI" />

[[File:Dathomir_undead.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Undeads in the Quarantine Zone.]]

Imperial operations in the Quarantine Zone were supervised by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself. In fact, the Dark Lord was not eager to lose the virus and the research data. He therefore ordered [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Piett]] to recruit volunteers in order to enter the quarantine zone and obtain a sample of the virus in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility. In the meantime, the situation was discovered by the Rebel Alliance and the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were tasked by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to contact Rebel agents and convince them to enter the Quarantine Zone to get the virus before the Empire. On the other hand, [[Guri]], the lieutenant of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of the Black Sun, traveled to the Quarantine Zone as well and recruited unaligned adventurers to find the virus for Xizor. Both the Rebellion and the Black Sun had managed to steal Imperial authorization codes, allowing their agents to enter the Zone.<ref name="SWG:MMR" />

Once in the Quarantine Zone, all those spacers had to fight against an extensive amount of aggressive undeads. The undeads included Imperial soldiers and prisoners from the Imperial Research and Prison Facility as well as indigenous Dathomiri [[Witches of Dathomir|Witches]]. The spacers fought and killed a large number of Individuals reanimated by the virus, including [[Fenn Kay'lay]], [[Vil Burren]], [[Jawiin Danod]], [[Salek Panaka]], [[Snotharr]], [[Navik Geelo]], [[Dugo Evnul]], [[Adol Mantid]], [[Tal Freykaa]], [[Kallaova]], [[Soon Dom]], [[Ool Awmod]], [[Jaina Nassin]], [[Wertsnik]], [[Wesk Kit'pay]], [[Ghianna Hayde]], [[Chak Krist]], [[Treena Moldovia]], [[Vina Maljazara]], and [[Pit Cornburr]].<ref name="SWG:UB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Undead Boss}}</ref>

[[File:RancorZombie.png|thumb|right|200px|Spacers fighting the [[undead rancor]].]]
The spacers later reached the Camp Epsilon in the courtyard of the Imperial Research and Prison Facility were they found a contingent of immune stormtroopers led by [[HX-138]].<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> The spacers intended to help the stormtroopers to get their support in finding the virus in the Research Facility.<ref name="SWG:StT" /> The spacers then entered the Research Facility itself where they were attacked by the most aggressive undead creatures.<ref name="SWG:WN">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|What Next?|Dathomir}}</ref> They even had to fight a giant [[undead rancor]] in the depths of the Facility.<ref name="SWG:GEUR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Group Event - Undead Rancor|Dathomir}}</ref> The spacer also encountered some survivors, including Dr. [[Nomi Rhane]]. Finally, the spacers found Doctor [[Griffax Jin]], chief virologist of the Imperial research project, who was still alive. However, the man was infected by the virus and soon turned into a zombie and attacked the spacers. After the scientist was definitely killed, one of the spacers managed to get a sample of the original virus in the lab, and eventually brought it to his employer.<ref name="SWG:WN" />

Because of the dangers of the area, those who survived in the area, regardless of whether they were Rebel Alliance-aligned, Imperial-aligned, or neutral, were awarded with the [[Quarantine Zone Survivor]] award.<ref name="SWG:QZA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Quarantine Zone Awards}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Quarantine Zone was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The areas surrounding the Quarantine Zone were added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 13|Game Update 13]]," released on [[September 30]], [[2009]],<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1003113|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 13 -- Chronicle Master System}}</ref> but it was only with the "[[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|Death Troopers]]" [[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|update]], released on [[October 12]], 2009,<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref> that players could access the area.<ref name="SWG:MMR" />
